g.text: Every shown endpoint: native field-tail PASS.
Both scalar gates give the same displayed brackets.
F = last tested fail; P = first tested pass.
Point = passing-pulse ratio; whiskers use both tested brackets.
Bracket envelope, not CI. Exact construction is in the caption.
Broader helps WP at the selected sizes; it delays smaller Gory,
shares the L19 bracket, then helps by L21 and at larger sizes.
Threshold searches retain scalar histories, tail summaries and
final fields, rather than full regional movies across the grid.
Increasing support at fixed requested peak also increases integrated cue. These comparisons sample two widths per size, rather than a complete width scan.
Existing success: persistent reversed scalar polarity near its initial magnitude after 10,000 cue-free units.

g.text: Field-tail qualification is separate; whole-field replacement is not implied. N = 201; no spatial-convergence claim.
